Definition
[derivation on tensors]

Source: petersen:page-0080

A derivation on tensors is a type-preserving linear map $T\mapsto DT$ that commutes with contractions and satisfies the product rule $D(T_1\otimes T_2)=(DT_1)\otimes T_2+T_1\otimes (DT_2)$.
